versions.changelog:
Initial release providing DAO and protocol treasury concentration analysis:

- Fetches live treasury composition data from the DeFiLlama treasury API (no API key required).
- Calculates percentage of treasury held in own governance token versus diversified assets (stablecoins, ETH, others).
- Assigns a risk label: DIVERSIFIED (<40% own token), MODERATE CONCENTRATION (40–70%), or TOKEN-CONCENTRATED (≥70%).
- Supports multiple protocol slugs and chains; displays results in table or JSON format.
- Gracefully handles protocols not tracked by the API, reporting errors per slug.
